method.codon_frequencies: F3x4 estimated from all 4,974 real alignments
method.tree: per-gene species tree (same topology/branch lengths as BUSTED runs), human foreground irrelevant under neutrality
method.missing_data: real gene per-species per-codon gap masks applied to simulated sequences
method.test: HyPhy BUSTED 2.5.101, --branches Test --srv No, 300s timeout, same pipeline as production

empirical_fdr.note: all simulated genes are true nulls (omega=1), so any BH rejection is a false positive

implication_for_1690: Simulated nulls reproduce a large point mass at p=0.5 (45.8%) with virtually no p>0.5 (0.0%) and near-nominal small-p tail (1.8% < 0.05, expected 5%): the bounded support arises from TRUNCATION (LRT<=0 clamped to p=0.5), not anti-conservative compression. Per bh_bounded_support_check.json, truncation leaves the BH procedure unchanged, so the 1,690 significant genes are not an artifact of the bounded support. The measured BH false-positive rate on simulated nulls is 0/400 = 0.0%.
